title: Project Relief Points on Network and Server Order Deposits
content:
Project relief points come off the infrastructure deposit percentage, the percentage at which the deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote is taken, when the client holds one or more Professional Services Projects engagements whose status is in progress, the largest class among them deciding: **5.0 points** when any of them is classed Standard Project, Advanced Project, Major Project or Strategic Program, **2.0 points** when every one of them is of a smaller class, that is Assessment Engagement or Quick Start Project, and none without an in-progress engagement.

Class and status are read from the client's project engagement records; only engagements whose status is in progress count.

| In-progress engagements | Points off |
|---|---|
| one Advanced Project | 5.0 |
| one Assessment Engagement and one Standard Project | 5.0 (the larger class decides) |
| one Quick Start Project | 2.0 |
| two Assessment Engagements | 2.0 |
| none in progress | none |
